title: Cultural Impact Assessment Methodological Approach
descriptions: This dataset presents a methodological framework for assessing the cultural impacts of creative newcomers in rural areas. It combines a PRISMA-based systematic literature review, co-occurrence analysis, and selected case analyses to develop a context-sensitive, multi-dimensional indicator framework.
